notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Maestro's Gift using convoke without paying mana.
description:
Cast Maestro's Gift using Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Inspired Skypainter.
When Inspired Skypainter enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
